securityTrack.F5B6_EXACT_BLOCKER: No approved ceremony that binds a destination device public key D to account P and seals identity material to D without MITM. Signer WebAuthn proves user presence on signer.sos010.com for local vault ops; it does not attest a remote Android/desktop Keystore key as the authorized migration target.
securityTrack.F5B6_CAN_REUSE_WEBAUTHN_NOTE: WebAuthn may later authorize packaging/consent on signer origin, but cannot alone authenticate destination device key D or prevent substitution of D during handoff.
securityTrack.F6H_HAS_OTHER_BLOCKERS: Recovery UX can use F5B5 visual nsec + F5B4 import as interim; sealed Worker→signer→Android path still needs F5B6
securityTrack.F6J_SCOPE: Android dark/internal production rollout of F6A–F6I native typed crypto (flags/APK); not Package 893; not F5B6/F6H sealed migration

linkedDevices.reason: Model B missing primitive is authenticated destination device key D under unchanged account P. QR phone↔desktop pairing that enrolls D is exactly that attestation. WebAuthn on signer does not create D.
linkedDevices.LINKED_DEVICE_SIGNING_MODEL_RECOMMENDATI: A_delegated_device_protocol_plus_optional_phone_cosign_for_P_authored_Nostr — not C (copy root K to every device)
linkedDevices.PHONE_REQUIRED_ONLINE_FOR_DESKTOP: CONDITIONAL — required only for ops that need Schnorr-under-P if desktop holds only D; not for local encrypted sync if capsule unwraps conversation keys
linkedDevices.STANDARD_NOSTR_INTEROP_IMPACT: Events signed by D are not standard kind authorship as P unless protocol adds device-delegation tags/proof or phone co-signs; copying K to desktop restores interop but expands compromise surface
linkedDevices.RECOVERY_CAPSULE_RECOMMENDED_CONTENT_CLA: K_wrapped_to_device_keys_D_i + encrypted_vault_metadata_snapshot + conversation_session_key_material_wrapped — never plaintext nsec

blockers.F5B_ISOLATED_SIGNER_STRONG_INTENT: PARTIAL — F5B5 WebAuthn export closed; admin-intent signer binding still open

communities.note: C1+ needs production AC semantics/bootstrap more than Linked Devices; Linked Devices is identity/multi-device, not community graph
